text: Checklist first line 'Replace the rotten floorboards (3 left)' renders in a smaller, different font than the other lines and is squeezed under the STEP header; tick ~5160

Rotten floorboard #2 (near x=-0.8,z=0.4, yaw ~296): with crosshair squarely on the visible dark/green rotten patch at pitch -64 from ~1m away, aim reads 'Floorboards' and holding LMB with the pry bar does nothing (ticks 9600-10630). Backing up to ~1.5m at pitch -50 with the crosshair on the patch's far tip finally reads 'Rotten floorboard'. Hit area seems smaller/offset vs the drawn patch. Screenshot shots/rotten_miss.png

walkto debris reported 'within reach' (0.95m, bearing -7) but E said 'Nothing to pick up there.' with the broken board visible just below the crosshair (pitch -33); the 12-degree forgiveness does not seem to cover pitch at close range

Floor gap hit area is offset from the drawn gap: at (-0.47,0.53) yaw 122.5 pitch -52.5 the crosshair is on plain floorboards to the lower-right of the visible green gap, yet aim reads 'Gap in the floor'; with the crosshair on the green strip itself (yaw 104.5, shots/g9.png) it read 'New floorboard'. Same pattern for rotten board #2 and gap #2 (yaw 293.5: 'Floorboards' with the gap just right of the crosshair). Each gap could be filled but only after hunting for the invisible hotspot.

Second time: broken board (window board) clearly visible ~15 deg above the crosshair, about 1m away, E says 'Nothing to pick up there.' Picking up pried-off boards needs near-exact aim; with several pieces this makes hauling the slowest part of Repair.

Roof: after patching 2 of 4 sections from (1.62,0.82), the checklist says '2 sections open' but a 360-degree look at pitch ~30-60 shows only dark ceiling boards and rafters: no sky or light marks where the remaining holes are. The first hole only showed as a small blue corner at the screen edge. Remaining sections not found before time ran out; the checklist line is also drawn dim/grey (looks done-ish).
